concepts: human tumor tissue metabolomics immune checkpoint inhibitor short chain fatty acids inosine mass spectrometry
What are the absolute concentrations of gut microbiota-derived metabolites like butyrate and inosine in human tumor microenvironment samples from patients responding to immunotherapy?
gap.question: Are there any primary studies reporting absolute quantitative concentrations (e.g., μM, ng/mg) of microbial metabolites (specifically Inosine, Butyrate, SCFAs) measured directly in human tumor tissue (TME) or paired tumor-serum samples from ICI-treated patients, and do these levels correlate with response?
success_criteria: Identification of at least one primary clinical study (not review) performing targeted metabolomics (e.g., LC-MS/MS, Mass Spectrometry Imaging) on human tumor tissues from ICI-treated cohorts, reporting specific concentration values and statistical correlation with ORR/PFS/OS.
gap.user_scope: How does the gut microbiome modulate the efficacy of immune checkpoint inhibitors in solid tumours, and what mechanisms mediate that effect?
